Its USD carrying amount is excluded from the USD-denominated borrowing measure. 2026-09-29: July repayment and renewal of a $26M unsecured facility, followed by a $26M redraw at 10.31%, maturing December 2026. Gross repayment and redraw do not establish a net debt increase. 2026-09-29: An additional $45M BIT Group USD facility was agreed in August. Aggregate USD facility principal outstanding was about $423.3M on September 29. The BTC facility is separate. 2026-09-29: The BTC facility became revolving in August, capped at 6,000 BTC. September 29 balance: about 3,669 BTC, after roughly 3,900 BTC draws and 2,185 BTC repayments since July 1. No current USD equivalent is asserted. 2026-09-29: July 1 to September 29 sales of 4,367,199 Class A shares generated $58M net proceeds. The $8.4M under the August 10 prospectus is a subset.
